builtInStudyReview: All six built-in ENTRIES studies were reviewed. None duplicates these 2 Peter or 1 John records. The 2 Peter 3:3, 3:9 and 3:10 records share verses with coverage-nt-peter-delay but address separate Greek-edition wording differences.
interpretationLimits: Edition-specific limits are retained; the served TR and Tischendorf editions are not treated as a critical apparatus or proof of the original reading. The Balaam record allows that Bosor and Beor may be forms of one name. The Q record names possible readings without selecting one. Annotation presence is not exhaustive review.
